definitions.explanation: a subject taught in Japanese elementary schools that combines drawing, painting, and handcraft activities

examples.japanese: {図画工作|ずがこうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like arts and crafts class.

examples.english: We made paper clay creations in arts and crafts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{図画工作|ずがこうさく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}い→描く：28436_kaku⟧たり、もの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っ→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧たり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
Composed of {図画|ずが} (drawing, painting) + ⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧ (crafts, construction). Often abbreviated as ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧ in everyday conversation. This is a required subject in Japanese elementary schools, covering both visual arts (drawing, painting, printmaking) and craft activities (clay work, woodworking, paper crafts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: arts and crafts class
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: arts and crafts period
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: arts and crafts project/work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{図工|ずこう}→図工：19698_zukou⟧: arts and crafts — the common abbreviation used by students and parents
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧: fine arts — the art subject in middle school and high school (replaces {図画工作|ずがこうさく})
- ⟦{工作|こうさく}→工作：12437_kousaku⟧: crafts — the hands-on making component alone
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: technical arts — a middle school subject covering woodworking, metalwork, and technology
